premise: After a night of rain Badger finds mushrooms everywhere, and Mushroom is delighted to have so many new friends.
inspiration: The magic porridge pot (Grimm), turned: overnight abundance that is lovely, not a problem, and the lonely one gets a family.
lesson: The world can surprise you with new friends overnight.

en-US.title: Mushrooms After Rain
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.6 9s} All night long, the rain fell on the forest, soft and steady. {sfx:night-rain solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.7 14s} [softly] In the morning, Badger {badger:pulse} poked his nose out of his burrow and blinked. [gasps] Mushrooms! Big ones, small ones, brown ones, white ones, everywhere he looked. Yesterday there had been only one mushroom {mushroom:pulse} in the whole clearing. Where did they all come from? Snail {snail:wobble} slid over, leaving a shiny trail. [curious] Mushrooms love rain, he said. After a wet night, they pop up everywhere. Pop, pop, pop! The mushroom {mushroom:hop} was so happy she wobbled. [excited] I've got a whole family now! Frog {frog:hop x2} hopped from cap to cap, counting. One, two, three, four… too many to count! [happily] And Badger said good morning {badger:hearts} to every single one.

es-ES.title: Setas después de la lluvia
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.6 9s} Toda la noche estuvo lloviendo sobre el bosque, suave y sin parar. {sfx:night-rain solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.7 14s} [softly] Por la mañana, Tejón {badger:pulse} asomó el hocico fuera de su madriguera y parpadeó. [gasps] ¡Setas! Grandes, pequeñas, marrones, blancas, por todas partes. Ayer solo había una seta {mushroom:pulse} en todo el claro. ¿De dónde habían salido todas? Caracol {snail:wobble} llegó deslizándose, dejando un rastro brillante. [curious] A las setas les encanta la lluvia, dijo. Después de una noche mojada, brotan por todas partes. ¡Pop, pop, pop! La seta {mushroom:hop} estaba tan contenta que se tambaleaba. [excited] ¡Ahora tengo una familia entera! Rana {frog:hop x2} saltaba de sombrero en sombrero, contando. Una, dos, tres, cuatro… ¡demasiadas para contarlas! [happily] Y Tejón dio los buenos días {badger:hearts} a todas y cada una.

night-rain.prompt: steady gentle rain falling on a forest at night, soft and calm
